# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 66 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 66

Jesus said: "Show me the stone that the builders rejected — that is the cornerstone."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Direct parallel to Psalm 118:22, cited in Mark 12:10, Matthew 21:42, Luke 20:17, Acts 4:11, 1 Peter 2:7
- In Thomas, the saying follows directly after the Wicked Tenants parable (Saying 65), as in the Synoptics
- "Show me" — Thomas adds an imperative not found in the Synoptic/Psalm versions
- **ⲡⲱⲛⲉ** / *pōne*: "stone" — the same word throughout
- "Cornerstone" / **ⲡⲉⲱⲛⲉ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲕⲁϩ** — literally "stone of the head of the corner"
